name: Electronics Technician rating mark
explanation: The specialty mark of the Electronics Technician rating: a helium atom — a nucleus with two electron orbits — with a lightning bolt, the symbol at the center of the ET rating badge. It is shown here on its own, in oxidized silver to match the pins.

name: Chief petty officer anchor
explanation: The fouled anchor — an anchor with line wrapped around the stock, with the letters USN — is how a chief petty officer is recognized: in gold on the combination cap and, smaller, on the collar of khakis. It is the rank mark of an E-7.
criteria: Worn after promotion to chief petty officer. Date of rank here is 16 September 2014.

name: Joint Communications Support Element device
explanation: The badge of the Joint Communications Support Element, the joint communications unit of the 2009–2015 tour.
criteria: Assignment to the Joint Communications Support Element.
